purpose: Autumn-recruitment project evaluation using ordinary single-page text questions over the documents already present in knowledge base 1
selectionPolicy: Keep the existing knowledge-base documents; do not upload, rebuild, or replace documents for this selection.
Use only original public-dataset questions whose complete evidence is on one physical page.
Require evidence_sources to be exactly Pure-text (Plain-text).
Exclude questions involving tables, charts, figures, diagrams, visual styling, cross-page aggregation, or multi-step arithmetic.
Prefer questions containing a distinctive entity, organization, acronym, product, or phrase that can locate the source without a documentId.
Do not enforce answer-format quotas or one-question-per-document quotas when those quotas would force unsuitable questions into the set.
